start_time_note: One row per boat per heat: no per-round results survive, so the number of rides per boat is not known (gap results_missing). Order: the official heat lists' start order (prelims, MK1 quarterfinals, junior semifinals); senior semifinal and final membership comes from the final classification (ranks 1-10 semis, 1-5 finals per the schedule's '2 heat x 5' / '1 heat x 5'), written in rank order. Times: heat time where the detailed schedule ver1 prints one; Wednesday MK1 heats from the competition schedule rule '1h per heat' with the printed breaks; Thursday times +1:30 h per the organiser delay notice; otherwise the programme block start (block_times). Each heat is one Race number. No per-ride clocks exist.
